raw.rationale: The compound is likely tetrabenazine or a related VMAT inhibitor whose targets (DRD2, SLC18A1/2) are not broadly expressed in common solid tumor lineages, so selective killing at 2.5 µM is unlikely; any apparent lineage selectivity would be rare and driven by neuroendocrine/neural-crest-like dependencies. Thus probabilities are near the low end of the 0.2–2.5% base rate, with slight enrichment for CNS and lung due to neuroendocrine features.
